claim: You can make one call to SubscribeToShard per second per registered consumer per shard. If you call SubscribeToShard again with the same ConsumerARN and ShardId within 5 seconds of a successful call, you get a ResourceInUseException.
question: How often can an enhanced fan-out consumer call SubscribeToShard?

values.display: one call to SubscribeToShard per second
